verdict.rationale: Whether user data is used for model training is a fair privacy question for a cloud-backed AI coding tool, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a data-retention control, or a no-training guarantee for any plan tier. The enterprise items cover SSO, a compliance API and managed policy settings but never mention training use, and the anti-distillation item is about Anthropic protecting its own outputs, not user data.
